description: LS20 saved_136: a single dark-red figure moves across a static yellow scene containing a green object. The authored expectation is that the figure occludes the background it passes over; the reader must not treat newly revealed background as created, nor treat the partly hidden green object as two separate objects.
requirements: Treat the dark-red figure as one persistent moving entity across all 14 frames.
Explain disappearing/reappearing background as occlusion by the figure, not creation or destruction.
When the figure overlaps the green object, prefer a single partly-occluded green object over two objects.
Do not certify a pass from a single frame; occlusion is a cross-frame inference with uncertainty.

teacher.note: No workbench oracle was executed for this real recording; this file carries authored expectations and real image hashes only.
